taxonomy.joint_vec_ai_cache_trace: A: temporally aligned vehicle/client mobility, RSU, model/cache object, size/reuse, and cost evidence
taxonomy.model_serving_request_trace: B: ordered requests with stable model identity but no real vehicle/RSU mobility
taxonomy.adapter_or_lora_workload_trace: C: ordered requests with reusable adapter/LoRA identity
taxonomy.kv_prefix_cache_trace: D: ordered requests with reusable prefix/KV object identity; not an adapter cache
taxonomy.model_artifact_size_metadata: E: model/weight/shard/cache artifact identity and bytes only
taxonomy.generic_ai_workload_trace: F: ordered AI jobs or requests without stable model/adapter identity
taxonomy.content_dataset_not_cache_trace: G: training/evaluation/content data without cache-workload semantics
taxonomy.paper_only_or_unavailable: H: paper/system artifact has no public qualifying real trace
taxonomy.rejected_or_unsafe: I: semantic mismatch, empty/unverifiable payload, unsafe provenance, or unacceptable terms
